newsitem.title: JAPAN: Societe Generale to cut Japan OTC brokerage fees.
newsitem.headline: Societe Generale to cut Japan OTC brokerage fees.

text.p: Societe Generale Securities Ltd said on Tuesday it would reduce brokerage fees on stocks traded on the Japanese over-the-counter market by 50 percent, starting with trade conducted on Wednesday.

Societe Generale officials said the fee reduction was necessary to remain competitive after French rivals such as Paribas Capital Markets Ltd and Credit Lyonnais Securities announced plans to cut their Japanese fees.

The rush to cut fees was ignited by one of Japan's smaller brokerages, Matsui Securities Co Ltd, which earlier this week announced plans to cut trading fees for over-the-counter stocks and convertible bonds in March.
Matsui said on Monday it was bringing the move forward to February 17 because of strong demand from investors.

Brokerage commissions for stocks listed on Japanese stock exchanges are fixed under the Securities and Exchange Act, while fees for over-the-counter trade can be set within a range fixed by the Japan Securities Dealers' Association.
But until now, brokers have charged uniform fees on stocks traded over the counter, market sources said.
